key_insight: SMART combines machine learning with Monte Carlo simulation to rapidly predict transistor aging and process-variation effects in digital circuits without expensive traditional reliability modeling.
engineering_relevance: The framework enables scalable, reliability-aware design exploration for deep-nanometer CMOS circuits by dramatically reducing analysis time while preserving high accuracy.
method: Uses Random Forest regression to predict gate delay distributions directly.
Applies Bayesian Optimization to tune model hyperparameters automatically.
Shifts heavy computation to an offline training phase to speed up online analysis.
evidence_signal: On ISCAS85 benchmark circuits, SMART reduced analysis time by 94.54% versus state-of-the-art methods while keeping average accuracy error to 1.63%.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the training data, so the model may need retraining or validation when applied to new libraries, technologies, or aging conditions.
paper_title: SMART: A Machine Learning and Monte Carlo Framework for Rapid Analysis of Stochastic Transistor Aging and Process Variation in Digital Circuits
